mapper.select: SELECT sp.id, sp.activity_id, sp.product_id, p.name AS product_name, p.image AS product_image, p.price AS original_price, sp.seckill_price, sp.seckill_stock, sp.sold_count, sp.limit_per_user, sp.status FROM seckill_product sp LEFT JOIN product p ON sp.product_id = p.id WHERE sp.activity_id = #{activityId} ORDER BY sp.create_time DESC
